name: r6d_TextAppend
notes: append an encoded string to a text box (hangs over 0x800 bytes); rep movsd/movsb copy written as __movsd/__movsb with a memcpy fallback

name: r6d_TextDraw
notes: draw a text box and its frame passes; calls 0x00076E30 with EAX=t ESI=0x80 EBX=ctx; 0x00076FA0 with EAX=t ESI=0x80; 0x000768D0 with EDI=t

name: r6d_TextDrawAlpha
notes: draw a text box faded to an alpha level; calls 0x00076E30 with EAX=t ESI=(alpha>>1)&0x7F EBX=ctx; 0x00076FA0 with EAX=t ESI=(alpha>>1)&0x7F

name: r6d_MenuShowText
notes: show a new message in the shop menu text box; float argument -1.0 pushed from .rdata by modern cl instead of as an immediate

name: r6d_ShopGive
notes: give the player one bought shop item; regargs: id=AX (zero-extended)

name: r6d_ShopCheck
notes: why a shop item cannot be bought (1 too expensive 2 unavailable 0 ok); regargs: id=SI (zero-extended)

name: r6d_MenuPageValue
notes: translate a menu value for the current shop page; calls 0x00060BF0 with EAX=v

name: r6d_MenuUpdate
notes: run the current shop page and update the menu animation

name: r6d_ItemPrice
notes: shop price of an item (item 28 halved until stat 0x29; 60 percent without the flag at 0x413178); multiply by 60 via imul in original vs shl/sub/shl in modern cl

name: r6d_ShopCloseStep
notes: shop close sequence (fade out then restore the game state and reset the page); 20.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata

name: r6d_LoadTexSet
notes: select a texture set and load its seven images into the work block; the conditional decrement (unsigned n>4) is made branchless with cmp/sbb by modern cl

name: r6d_StatusIcon
notes: icon index for entry k of the current status page; regargs: k=EDX

name: r6d_StatusShowText
notes: show a message in status text box i; regargs: i=ESI; float argument -1.0 pushed from .rdata by modern cl instead of as an immediate

name: r6d_StatusShowTextS
notes: stack-argument wrapper; calls 0x00065E50 with ESI=i (modern cl tail-calls it)

name: r6d_AreaLoadImages
notes: pick the area picture for the current chapter and stage and load four images; calls 0x0006B5E0 with ECX=chapter EAX=stage ESI=0x003E65E8

name: r6d_PauseRelease
notes: leave the pause screens: stop sounds and release every page and the work block

name: r6d_PausePageValue
notes: pass a menu value to the handler of the current pause page; regargs: v=EAX; returns v for unknown pages

name: r6d_PauseShowValue
notes: in page 10000 translate a value and show it; calls 0x0006C160 with EAX=v

name: r6d_PausePageRun
notes: run the current pause page (tail calls)

name: r6d_Forward13
notes: forward thirteen arguments to 0x001A78F0 and return the first argument

name: r6d_PauseHandlesInit
notes: mark all 32 pause-screen sound handles free

name: r6d_MenuSetOrder
notes: set the four draw-order slots of a menu for a layout mode and selection; regargs: m=EAX sel=ECX mode=DX (zero-extended)

name: r6d_PausePageStopSounds
notes: release the sound handles of the current pause page

name: r6d_ModelSetUV2
notes: register a model in the effect list and set the second UV offset of every active part with a key; hangs on NULL or unknown type

name: r6d_ModelSetUV1
notes: set the first UV offset of every active part with a key; regargs: m=EAX key=EBX v=EDI

name: r6d_WaitForKey
notes: block until the pad is idle and key 0x2BC has been pressed and released

name: r6d_EndingStep
notes: ending sequence step: start the credits fade then switch to chapter 0x18

name: r6d_DrawCentredMessage
notes: draw message 3 centred with a four-way shadow; calls 0x00079590 with EAX=x ECX=ctx; 0x0003FA70 called with two arguments (alias r6d_MsgGet)

name: r6d_DrawString
notes: draw an encoded string glyph by glyph; regargs: x=EAX ctx=ECX; the original pushes an unused third argument 0 to 0x00076430; the two 1.0f arguments are built with fld1 by modern cl instead of pushed as immediates

name: r6d_NodeAdd
notes: allocate a 0x84-byte named node and append it to the owner list at +0x1F8; returns the node

name: r6d_SceneFree
notes: free every child of a scene object and its six resource slots (slot helper inlined six times as in the original)

name: r6d_CopyN
notes: copy at most max bytes of src to dst and return dst advanced; regargs: max=EAX src=EBX

name: r6d_CharLoad
notes: load a character resource into an object and create its effect list; calls 0x0007E680 with EDI=table; 0x0007E720 with EBX=o->chr

name: r6d_TableFirstFree
notes: first table entry with bit 0 at +0x0C clear (0 found / -1 none); regargs: t=EDI; integer compare operands swapped on the loop entry test (cmp i;[t] jge vs cmp [t];i jle)

name: r6d_MemFill
notes: fill n bytes and return 0 (rep stosd/stosb written as __stosd/__stosb with a memset fallback); the fill byte is copied into the second byte with mov bh;bl by the original vs shl 8 by modern cl

name: r6d_MemCopy
notes: copy n bytes and return 0 (rep movsd/movsb written as __movsd/__movsb with a memcpy fallback)

name: r6d_StrCompare
notes: compare two strings four bytes at a time; NULL a gives -1 and NULL b gives 1

name: r6d_TreeCollect
notes: collect visible items of a scene box tree into the draw list (max 256); recursion on the left child and a loop on the right child as in the original

name: r6d_SlotsAlloc
notes: remember a table and allocate one zeroed 8-byte slot per entry (rep stos written as __stosd/__stosb with a memset fallback)

name: r6d_BoxCorners
notes: write the eight corners of the box lo..hi copying raw words

name: r6d_TexHeaderInit
notes: initialise a P2IG texture header (name up to 8 characters; log2 of width and height capped at 32); modern cl merges the two halfword stores of 1 into one dword store of 0x10001 (in image range so listed as data) and the two zero byte stores into one halfword store and addresses the second name word directly

name: r6d_SoundUpdate
notes: update a playing sound: on end stop the sounds of its group; stop early once its event flag is set; the slot loop pointer is strength-reduced to the handle field (-8/-4 offsets) by the original vs indexed by modern cl

name: r6d_StreamsStop
notes: stop both busy streaming voices and wait until idle (job entry point; argument unused)

name: r6d_StreamLoadStep
notes: resumable job step: find the first stream set entry whose event flag is set and load it (direct on the job thread or as queued jobs)

name: r6d_StreamFreeStep
notes: resumable job step: release the current stream set entry

name: r6d_StreamPlay
notes: resumable job step: start stream (a b) on the third voice

name: r6d_StreamSwitch
notes: resumable job step: switch the third voice to stream (a b)

name: r6d_CsAudioInA
notes: cutscene audio in layout A: pause music tracks and start voice 0x0E with busy waits (voice helpers inlined)

name: r6d_CsAudioOutA
notes: cutscene audio out layout A: resume tracks and stop voice 0x0E then send the stage key handshake

name: r6d_CsAudioInB
notes: cutscene audio in layout B (voices 0x0F and 9)

name: r6d_CsAudioOutB
notes: cutscene audio out layout B

name: r6d_CsAudioInC
notes: cutscene audio in layout C (voice 0x10)

name: r6d_CsAudioOutC
notes: cutscene audio out layout C

name: r6d_CsEventA
notes: cutscene event A: cue 0x0D on track 2 until flag 4 then end (states 0/10/20)

name: r6d_CsKeyWait
notes: send the stage key through the two-argument handshake

name: r6d_CsEventB
notes: cutscene event B: cue chosen by stage 5 or 0x0B on track 3

name: r6d_CsAudioInD
notes: cutscene audio in layout D (voice 8)

name: r6d_CsAudioOutD
notes: cutscene audio out layout D

name: r6d_CsEventC
notes: cutscene event C: cues 3 and 4 on track 2; ends when tracks 2 and 5 are done

name: r6d_ScnLeaveCurrent
notes: step the leave sequence of the current event scene (1 while running); calls 0x00088240 with ESI=&scene record (0x18 bytes at 0x002E0680)

name: r6d_NodePairAt
notes: the n-th matching node of an object and the next matching node after it (both NULL when missing)

name: r6d_StageSetMaterial
notes: switch an object material keeping reference counts and render state 4

name: r6d_StageObjFree
notes: destroy a stage object and everything it owns (0xB0-byte state block copied back); the unsigned slot count test n<=0 (jbe) is emitted as n==0 (je) by modern cl

name: r6d_LinkDetachSound
notes: detach a link sound from its target effect list and clear the link words

name: r6d_LinkStopSound
notes: stop the sound playing on the link target

name: r6d_LinkCompare
notes: order two links by 0x0008B320 then by word +0x10 then by word +0x14

name: r6d_LinkAttachA
notes: attach a type-7 node for a source to a link creating it when missing (0 / -2 / attach error)

name: r6d_LinkAttachB
notes: attach a type-7 node for a source to a link (variant returning early)
